name: Cards
visualCharacteristics: Image grid: 4:3 image tiles (2 per row, 3 from 768px, 4 from 1280px); a tile with extra content opens it in an overlay dialog. Small and logo looks for denser grids and partner logos.
contentPattern: One row per tile: cell 1 the image, optional cell 2 the overlay content (heading, text, CTA links in bold). Use with the image-grid class; add small (3 / 4 / 6 per row) and/or logo (transparent tile, image contained) on top of image-grid. Without image-grid it falls back to boilerplate cards (image + body per row).
usage: Image grids that open an overlay (For Partners, Get Certified, Get Started, Korea home) and retailer logo grids (Where to Buy).
reuseGuidance: Reuse for a grid of image tiles that each reveal more detail in an overlay, or a wall of partner logos (image-grid small logo). For story or article teasers that link to a page, use Teaser Grid instead.
